notes.title: Small update.
notes.notes:
Some fixes and additions.

- Potentially vastly improved load times when starting a new run
- Polished Wolfgun's combo kit
- Added new entity: DNA
- Added new music track for dimensions: Tides

Due to Unity's new pricing scheme I am now forced to enable the display of the splash screen. Disappointing but unavoidable.

Visit my discord to complain or praise: https://discord.gg/GABaUZJERB

Thanks to everyone who has played and enjoyed projections.

notes.title: PROJECTIONS Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! PROJECTIONS is now available for purchase on Steam. I hope you will enjoy playing through the story and learning about this new Universe.

The Projections OST is also available on my Bandcamp [url=https://wolfgun.bandcamp.com/album/projections-the-ost]RIGHT HERE[/url], as a free / pay what you want download. You can donate if you like, or you can just enter "0" to download the music for free!

I'll continue to update PROJECTIONS in the coming days to polish certain things. There are many small things I want to keep improving / tidy up.

Regarding the future of PROJECTIONS, I want to say that any and ALL future updates will be completely free. I will never charge for DLC: updating the game, adding new music, new content, etc. will all be entirely free.

Lastly, please join me in my [url=http://discord.gg/galaxy-pals]DISCORD SERVER[/url] and talk about your experiences in-game, about the story, the music - Share screenshots, bugs (oh no), whatever.

Thank you for reading, and I hope you enjoy the game and its music!
